_what: The values the Galaxy filter runs on (creative_filter.py holds the rules). Change a number here, never in code. Every weight says where it comes from.

gates._why: A candidate is cut before scoring when it has no proof, no real line to open on, or a cap is already full.

depth._why: A profile filled from more real lines is a truer target. Under these counts a profile is marked thin and weighs less (it is never cut).

weights._why: Exponents on each part of the score: proof (sales) leads, watch (hold + click) next, then the point, then profile depth.

media._why: Meta: 9:16 video with audio has 34.5% lower cost per result than image ads; ad sets need at least 20% of assets 9:16 with sound (META.md section 3).

point_kind._why: What a hook can open on. A lived moment or a feeling stops the scroll fastest; a doubt is better answered mid-ad.

caps._why: Spread inside one lane's picks, so Meta gets truly different creatives and not one idea many times (dimensions.json spread rule: no value fills more than half).

settings._what: Where the ad is seen, from the matrix's own setting list. A point whose words name a place opens there; otherwise the least-used setting is taken.

not_an_opener._why: A line about ordering, shipping, discounts or the brand itself is a service note, not a moment a hook can open on. Such a line weighs this much.

daily._what: How many picks per lane each day, in the order they are chosen (later lanes are kept apart from earlier ones). Video first: it is the core (owner, 2026-11-27).

lanes._what: The three lanes. media: what is made. per_winner: rows one proven ad may have in a lane. needs: which formats qualify (formats-standard.json internal / creators flags). The maker and door per lane live in formats-standard.json.
